testDescription: Pelvic Organ Prolapse/Urinary Incontinence Sexual Questionnaire (PISQ-12)

questions.text: How frequently do you feel sexual desire? This feeling may include wanting to have sex, planning to have sex, feeling frustrated due to lack of sex, etc.
Do you climax (have an orgasm) when having sexual intercourse with your partner?
Do you feel sexually excited (turned on) when having sexual activity with your partner?
How satisfied are you with the variety of sexual activities in your current sex life?
Do you feel pain during sexual intercourse?
Are you incontinent of urine (leak urine) with sexual activity?
Does fear of incontinence (either stool or urine) restrict your sexual activity?
Do you avoid sexual intercourse because of bulging in the vagina (either the bladder, rectum, or vagina falling out)?
When you have sex with your partner, do you have negative emotional reactions such as fear, disgust, shame or guilt?
Does your partner have a problem with erections that affects your sexual activity?
Does your partner have a problem with premature ejaculation that affects your sexual activity?
Compare to orgasms you've had in the past, how intense are the orgasms you've had in the past six months?
Because of my pelvic pain

labels.0: I can wear whatever I like; I have no pelvic pain because of clothing.
labels.1: I sometimes dislike the feel of clothes, but most of the time I don't feel pelvic pain caused by pressure from my clothing.
labels.2: I can wear close fitting clothing as long as it only puts a little pressure over my painful area.
labels.3: I can't wear tight fitting clothing like pantyhose that puts any pressure over my painful area.

questions.text: Because of my pelvic pain

labels.0: I have a hard time walking because of another medical problem, but pelvic pain doesn't make it hard to walk.
labels.1: My pain does not get worse with walking; I can walk as far as I want.
labels.2: I can only walk about 1 mile. I can walk a short distance outside the house, but it is very painful to walk far enough to get a full half of groceries in a store within a 1 mile walk.
labels.3: I can only walk when I must. I can only walk far enough to move around in my house, no farther.

questions.text: Because of my pelvic pain

labels.0: My pain does not get worse with sitting; I can sit as long as I want.
labels.1: I occasionally get pain when I sit, but most of the time sitting is comfortable.
labels.2: I get pain when I sit, so I can sit for longer than 30 minutes at a time, but it is painful that it is difficult to do my job or sit long enough to eat.
labels.3: I get pain when I sit, so I cannot sit for longer than 30 minutes.

questions.text: Because of my pelvic pain

labels.0: I can do all my work, and go out in the evening if I want to, but I feel a lot of ache.
labels.1: I am considered full, but long enough to do my work, but I can't do more, like going out in the evenings.
labels.2: I can do some work, but I have trouble accomplishing at work or while I do housework.
labels.3: I am not doing any work or housework because of my pelvic pain.

questions.text: Because of my pelvic pain

labels.0: I get together with friends or go to events whenever I want, pelvic pain does not get in the way.
labels.1: I get together with friends or go to events whenever I want, even if my pelvic pain gets worse and then I don't go because of the pain.
labels.2: I only get together with my friends or go out to parties or events every now and then.
labels.3: I have constant pain that makes it hard to do anything social.

questions.text: Because of my pelvic pain

labels.0: It never hurts for the doctor to insert the speculum when I go to the gynecologist.
labels.1: It usually doesn't hurt when the doctor inserts the speculum, but every now and then it does hurt.
labels.2: I can stand it when the doctor inserts the speculum if they are very careful, but most of the time it really hurts.
labels.3: I can't stand for the doctor to insert the speculum when I go to the gynecologist.

questions.text: Because of my pelvic pain

labels.0: It never hurts to use tampons.
labels.1: It usually doesn't hurt to use tampons, but occasionally it does hurt.
labels.2: I can only use tampons if I put them in very carefully.
labels.3: I cannot use tampons at all, because they make my pain much worse.

questions.text: Because of my pelvic pain

labels.0: It doesn't hurt to have my partner put a finger or penis in my vagina at all.
labels.1: It usually doesn't hurt if my partner puts a finger or penis in my vagina, but every now and then it does hurt.
labels.2: My partner can put a finger or penis in my vagina very carefully, but it still hurts.
labels.3: I can't let my partner put a finger or penis in my vagina during sex at all.

questions.text: Because of my pelvic pain

labels.0: It never hurts for my partner to touch me sexually outside the vagina.
labels.1: It doesn't usually hurt for my partner to touch me sexually outside the vagina, but every now and then it does hurt.
labels.2: My partner can touch me sexually outside the vagina if we are very careful.
labels.3: It hurts too much for my partner to touch me sexually even if the touching doesn't go in my vagina.

questions.text: Because of my pelvic pain

labels.0: It never hurts to touch myself for sexual pleasure.
labels.1: It usually doesn't hurt to touch myself for sexual pleasure, but every now and then it does hurt.
labels.2: I can touch myself for sexual pleasure if I am very careful.
labels.3: It is too painful to touch myself for sexual pleasure.

_note: Questions 1-10 share the same prompt 'Because of my pelvic pain' but each has a unique set of 4 radio options. Each option's text IS the answer content; the scale value is its index.
